integrity: The constructive argument gives a mathematical proof; finite rational tests are only corroboration. No independently checked mathematical correctness or originality is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Exact threshold is specific to closed skeleta of nondegenerate simplices; does not extend as stated to arbitrary convex bodies. Older equivalence in sparse matrix decompositions remains a historical possibility.
title: Sharp finite convexification thresholds for every skeleton of a simplex
